title: L'Oréal leads funding round for Chinese biotech company PAM2L
summary: L'Oréal’s strategic corporate venture capital fund BOLD said it will leverage its beauty and formulation expertise to explore the broader scientific value of innovative bio-actives via a minority investment in PAM2L Biotechnologies
